meta.title: DJI drone live streaming guides — Stream My Drone blog
meta.description: DJI Flip, Lito, Air, Mavic and Mini live streaming guides: controller compatibility, phone and computer setup, DJI Fly RTMP, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook.

lead: Choose your drone or platform: Flip, Lito X1 and Lito 1, Air, Mavic and Mini controller setups, phone and computer workflows, DJI Fly RTMP settings, and checks before you go live.

cta.h: Take your drone live from your phone
cta.p: Stream My Drone for Android and iPhone receives the DJI Fly picture and sends it to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitch, Kick or your own server, several at once. One-time purchase, no subscription.

guides.sub: Step-by-step instructions for your drone, controller and platform.

app.h: Go live from your phone, no computer needed
app.p: Stream My Drone runs on a phone next to your controller: it receives the DJI Fly picture over Wi-Fi and sends it straight to your platforms. No laptop, no cables, no server.
points: Type one address into DJI Fly and the picture appears in seconds
YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitch, Kick and custom RTMP, several at once
Destinations reconnect on their own after a short network drop
app.gallerySub: From the DJI Fly connection to a broadcast on several platforms, all on one screen.
